application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions:
The applicant is advised that this condition hereby approved C2 Travel Plan PART A and PART B is granted in part ONLY.  PARTS C and D remain outstanding and should be submitted to and approved to the Council. The condition is set out below for reference. 

Travel Plan 
Prior to the occupation of the unit by a food retailer: 
a.	a scheme detailing the monitoring arrangements of the Travel Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing with the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be occupied other than in accordance with the approved scheme.
b.	a scheme detailing the survey methodology for staff and travel surveys shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
c.	Within 6 months of the use hereby approved commencing, a travel plan based on the results of a TRICS-compliant staff travel survey shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. This shall contain clear objectives, targets, actions and timeframes to manage the transport needs of staff, to minimise car usage and to achieve a shift to alternative transport modes.
d.	Following approval by the Local Planning Authority, the applicant shall then implement these actions to secure the objectives and targets within the approved plan. The travel plan (including post-occupation surveys) shall be annually revised and a written review of the travel plan submitted and approved by Council by the anniversary of its initial approval and yearly thereafter for 5 years. After the fifth year, a travel plan is to be submitted and approved by the Local Authority quinquennially for the lifetime of the development. 
REASON: In order to comply with the objectives of national and local Planning Policies which promote sustainable development with particular regard to transport.
